info.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX3
info.author: openDJ authors (adapted for Mixxx 2.6)
info.description: Mixxx 2.6 adaptation of openDJ's GPL-2.0 Pioneer XDJ-RX3 PC control (MIDI) mode mapping: 4 decks, mixer, Beat FX (EffectUnit1), Color FX, Pad FX (EffectUnit1-4), Stems (4 stems), Hot Cue, Beat Loop, Slip Loop, Beat Jump, Sampler, Key Shift, VU meters, and jog displays. Generated from AlphaTheta's XDJ-RX3 MIDI Message List; untested on physical hardware.
